name: Mark Dixson
current_role: Executive Chair, International Workplace Group plc (IWG, owner of Regus); was CEO until June 2026
profile: Mark Dixon (name usually spelled Dixon) is a British entrepreneur who founded Regus in Brussels in 1989. It grew into International Workplace Group (IWG), the world's largest flexible-workspace operator, with brands like Regus and Spaces in 120+ countries. In June 2026 he handed the CEO job to Christian Schmitz and became Executive Chair.
interesting_fact: He got the idea for Regus in the late 1980s in Brussels, after seeing business travellers with nowhere professional to work. That first Brussels business centre grew into a network in more than 120 countries.
deep_cut_fact: He left school at 16 and started Dial-a-Snack, a sandwich business that delivered on a butcher's bicycle. After that came a hot dog van in 1983 and The Bread Roll Company in 1986, all before Regus.
notes: The input spells the name 'Dixson'; the correct spelling is Mark Dixon. IWG's head office is in Zug, Switzerland. In the June 2026 leadership-change RNS, Richard Manning (Head of IR) is the named contact. I found no published press email for him.
